course_name: Fundamentals of Survey Sampling & Frame Design
description: Master multistage stratified random sampling, cluster weight allocation, and PPS techniques used across national socioeconomic surveys.

course_name: Field Scrutiny, Validation Rules & CAPI Protocols
description: Practical workflows for inspecting field schedules, detecting cross-schedule contradictions, and ensuring high-fidelity data capture.
In-depth treatment of extreme survey values, Cook's distance, cold-deck vs hot-deck imputation, and sensitivity testing.

course_name: Non-Sampling Error Prevention in Household Surveys
description: Tactics for reducing respondent recall lapses, non-response conversion strategies, and interviewer bias minimization.
Step-by-step guidance on setting up supervisory audit sampling, independent re-interviews, and automated data validation rules.

course_name: MoSPI Classification Standards: NIC, NCO & NDSAP
description: Overview of standard enterprise and occupational classifications (NIC 2008, NCO 2015) and open data sharing compliance.

course_name: Data Privacy & Legal Ethics under Statistics Act 2008
description: Essential legal mandates, handling confidential respondent identifiers, anonymization techniques, and data security norms.

course_name: Price Statistics & Consumer Price Index (CPI) Compilation
description: Comprehensive guide on market quotation collection, geometric mean aggregation, weighting diagrams, and inflation indexation.

course_name: Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) & State Accounts
description: Practical methodology for calculating state-level value added across agriculture, industry, and tertiary services.
Transforming complex demographic surveys into clear infographics, charts, and public reports for policymakers and citizens.
